Basically, it's the "pluck 'em" method, but I'll elaborate a bit on what I do exactly.

For a cup of tea, I use between 7-10 leaves depending on how strong I want it and how strong the leaves smell (they do vary depending on conditions.).

I pluck them right from the stems, trying not to take too many from any individual plant. Not that it really seems to matter...these things are nearly indestructible!

Then I give them a good rinse, since you never know what's been crawling on them.

Finally, I boil some water, toss the leaves in the bottom of a cup, and pour the water right over them. I let them steep about 5 minutes, give or take...again, depending on how strong I want it. Add a bit of sugar or honey and it's sipping time!

Plant looks great, btw :)
